# Luna-12E - Computational Topology Integration and Causal Learning Verification

Read `workflow/ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.md`, `workflow/ARCHITECTURE_CHANGELOG.md`,
`workflow/docs/luna/LUNA_WORKFLOW.md`,
`workflow/docs/architecture/ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA.md`,
`workflow/docs/luna/AGENT_HANDOFF_TEMPLATE.md`, the Luna-12D handoff, and the
Luna-2/Luna-4/Luna-10/Luna-12B handoffs before editing. Record the exact
baseline revision and preserve unrelated worktree changes.

## Authorization and ownership

This dispatch is blocked until Luna-12D completes and Luna-0 reviews its
observational evidence. Do not begin implementation from this prompt alone.
When authorized, own the experiment-path integration, controlled causal
interventions, focused tests, and
`workflow/handoffs/computational-topology-integration-causal-learning-Luna-12E.md`.
Do not select or benchmark a real dataset or accept hardware behavior.

## Architectural boundary

Use one existing finite Luna-4 topology as both the structural-plasticity
resource and the actual event-routing network. Do not create a second graph,
introduce a global neural clock, bypass finite propagation, leak global
learning state, or weaken A01-A15. Preserve local prediction/error, delayed
credit, bounded state, local energy, and label isolation. Visualization and
analysis remain downstream-only.

## Required work after authorization

1. Route experiment events through the persistent bounded topology and prove
   that computation and structural mutation observe the same edges.
2. Use controlled reachable-edge removal and addition interventions with
   matched controls. Show downstream activity changes when the changed path is
   relevant, and distinguish unreachable or non-exercised edits.
3. Compute prediction/error behavior from propagated network activity and
   compare classification, loss, reward, utility, event, activation, and
   connectivity metrics under the interventions.
4. Verify finite propagation, fan-in/out and state bounds, deterministic
   replay, capture-on/off non-interference, local evidence, and absence of
   topology-only observational shortcuts.

## Completion and handoff

Run focused integration and causal tests plus relevant regression,
compile/diagnostic, and `git diff --check` checks. Record workload/configuration,
seeds, intervention endpoints, reachability, controls, metrics, tolerances,
passed/failed/not-run checks, and remaining risks. Return the evidence to
Luna-0; do not claim core promotion or hardware equivalence.
